note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual inputs.

Please provide:
- The full transcript (doctor–patient conversation).
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format.

Tips to ensure accuracy:
- Include all clinically relevant details from the transcript: presenting complaint, onset/duration/progression, past medical history, meds, allergies, social history (if applicable), physical findings, and any stated plans or follow-up.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, note that the dose/route/frequency is not documented.
- Use American English, concise professional tone, and structure exactly as requested.
- If the transcript and DDx conflict, I will include both and mark “conflict noted.”

Once you provide the transcript and DDx, I will produce:
- Subjective
- Objective
- Assessment & Plan with up to five issues (as applicable)
- Quality checks (documentQuality) including any missing elements or conflicts

Please paste the transcript and the DDx JSON.
